_provenance.reference: signal-cli 0.14.x src/main/java/org/asamk/signal/json/JsonDataMessage.java (attachments[], included only when non-empty) and JsonAttachment.java (contentType, filename, id, size, width, height, caption, uploadTimestamp, isVoiceNote). The id is the stored file's name under <data-dir>/attachments (lib/.../storage/AttachmentStore.java: sanitized remote id + extension from the filename or the content type), which is what getAttachment takes. Values are synthetic; only the FIELD NAMES and nesting are the claim.
_provenance.note: Transcribed from signal-cli source, NOT captured from a live account. A voice note carries no filename and isVoiceNote=true; Signal records voice as audio/aac. message may be null for an attachment-only message.
